title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Seriously Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference

Fa Fa [2010] No. 58

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

The Central Economic Work Conference, held from December 10 to 12 this year, closely focused on the theme of scientific development and the main thread of accelerating the transformation of the economic development model. It comprehensively summarized the achievements in economic and social development made this year and during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan period, scientifically analyzed the current international and domestic economic situation, and made detailed arrangements for next year's economic work. This is of great significance for unifying the understanding of the entire Party, strengthening the confidence of all parties, and rallying the strength of the nation to make a good start for economic and social development during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period. Conscientiously implementing the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference, earnestly carrying out all adjudication and enforcement work, fully exercising judicial functions, and providing a strong judicial guarantee and high-quality judicial services to promote steady and rapid economic development are important tasks for the people's courts at present and in the coming period. This notice is hereby issued regarding the study and implementation of the spirit of the conference as follows:

1. Deeply understand the significance of the Central Economic Work Conference, and effectively enhance the sense of responsibility, mission, and urgency in promoting steady and rapid economic development.

People's courts at all levels shall promptly organize all judicial officers to study and understand the spirit of the conference and earnestly implement the conference's spirit. They shall accurately grasp the opportunities and challenges facing China's economic development under the new situation, deeply understand the complexity and difficulty of next year's economic work tasks, further enhance their sense of responsibility, mission, and urgency, and effectively unify their thinking and actions with the Central Government's scientific judgment of the international and domestic situation, with the Central Government's decisions and deployments for economic and social development, and with the major responsibilities and tasks undertaken by the people's courts. They shall fully exercise their adjudicative functions to provide a more powerful judicial guarantee for promoting steady and rapid economic development.

2. Deeply understand the impact of economic situation developments and changes on the work of the people's courts, and effectively strengthen judicial response work.

People's courts at all levels shall have a clear understanding of the developments and changes in the economic situation, especially the adverse conditions affecting next year's economic work, effectively enhance their awareness of potential dangers and risks, closely monitor new changes in the economic situation, and proactively prepare judicial responses. They shall continue to adhere to an active judicial role, closely revolve around the Central Government's overall deployment for next year's economic work, conduct in-depth research and investigation, accurately grasp the profound impact of changes in the macroeconomic situation on the work of the people's courts, accurately grasp the new requirements of the overall economic development situation for judicial work, accurately grasp the urgent expectations of various market entities for equal protection of their legitimate rights and interests by the people's courts, and promptly issue and improve judicial policies, measures, and guiding documents to promote steady and rapid economic development, ensuring that the work of the people's courts always serves the overall situation of economic and social development, always serves scientific development, and always serves the main thread of accelerating the transformation of the economic development model.

3. Deeply understand the close connection between adjudication work and promoting the transformation of the economic development model, and effectively adjudicate and enforce related cases.

People's courts at all levels shall continue to firmly grasp the primary task of handling cases and enforcing judgments. Focusing on the main tasks for next year's economic work established by the Central Economic Work Conference, they shall conscientiously adjudicate and enforce various types of dispute cases arising in the process of strengthening and improving macro-control, promoting modern agricultural development, accelerating strategic adjustment of the economic structure, improving basic public services, intensifying reform efforts, and expanding international economic cooperation, providing a strong judicial guarantee and service for accelerating the transformation of the economic development model. They shall properly adjudicate various financial disputes, contract disputes, and other cases to maintain a good market economic order; properly adjudicate cases involving equity disputes, corporate bankruptcy, restructuring and reorganization, compulsory liquidation, etc., to promote the optimization of the industrial structure; properly adjudicate cases concerning people's livelihoods such as labor employment, social insurance, education and medical care, food and drug safety, and housing consumption, to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people; properly adjudicate agricultural-related cases such as disputes over the transfer of rural land contractual management rights and homestead disputes, to protect farmers' interests according to law, promote agricultural development, and maintain rural stability; properly adjudicate intellectual property cases, strengthen judicial protection for independent innovation, and promote the construction of an innovative country; properly adjudicate cases concerning environmental pollution compensation and energy conservation and emission reduction, to promote the construction of a resource-saving and environment-friendly society; properly adjudicate foreign-related commercial and maritime cases, to promote the in-depth development of foreign trade and international economic cooperation. They shall further strengthen the awareness of judicial service for the people, innovate judicial convenience mechanisms, implement judicial convenience measures, and open channels for communication with the people, providing the people with high-quality and efficient judicial services.

4. Deeply understand the importance of maintaining social stability for promoting economic development, and effectively promote the resolution of social conflicts and innovation in social management.

People's courts at all levels shall strictly adhere to the requirement that "stability is a hard task and a primary responsibility," and deeply advance the resolution of social conflicts and innovation in social management, creating a stable and harmonious social environment for promoting scientific development. They shall adhere to the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. On the one hand, they shall severely punish crimes endangering national security, serious violent crimes, and frequent property crimes according to law, and punish economic crimes and duty-related crimes according to law, to maintain social stability. On the other hand, they shall do a good job in education, persuasion, and redemption, minimizing confrontational factors and maximizing harmonious factors to the greatest extent. They shall adhere to the working principle of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication," integrating mediation work into the entire process of adjudication and enforcement, striving to resolve social conflicts at their root, achieving the goals of case closed, matter resolved, and harmony restored. They shall continue to promote the construction of a dispute resolution mechanism that connects litigation and non-litigation, and promote the improvement of the "grand mediation" pattern integrating people's mediation, administrative mediation, and judicial mediation, working together to resolve social conflicts. They shall adhere to the Party's mass line, take charge of litigation-related petition work by relying on mass work, firmly establish a mass viewpoint, always stand on the side of the masses, actively respond to the concerns of the masses, and strive to do practical things and solve difficult problems for the people. They shall adhere to the principle of prevention first, actively participate in comprehensive social management and the creation of a safe society, establish a risk assessment mechanism for social stability, and prevent and reduce social conflicts at the source. They shall actively participate in the management of special groups through education and assistance, the management of the virtual society on the internet, and other work, striving to create a good legal environment for economic development.

5. Deeply understand the prominent problems existing in the construction of the people's courts themselves, and effectively improve the level of serving economic and social development.

People's courts at all levels shall always adhere to the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," and in light of the new requirements of economic and social development and the new expectations of the people, they shall earnestly examine the prominent problems in their own work and construction, and effectively improve all aspects of their work. They shall focus on deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms, and in accordance with the principle of "grasping the direction, basing on national conditions, advancing according to law, and ensuring justice," they shall strive to complete and implement various judicial reform tasks, innovate and strengthen trial management, and continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of trials. They shall focus on strengthening Party building to lead the team building, continue to deeply carry out the theme practice activity of "People's judges for the people" and the activity of striving for excellence, strive to improve the political, professional, and professional ethics qualities of judges, and enhance the ability and level to resolve social conflicts and serve economic development. They shall focus on strengthening the grassroots level and building a solid foundation, comprehensively strengthen the basic work and infrastructure construction of the courts, further strengthen guidance for grassroots work, so that grassroots courts and people's tribunals can fully play their role as frontline positions in serving economic and social development.

Please report to our court in a timely manner on the implementation of the spirit of this conference.

December 15, 2010
